question: to the Commission Aodhán Ó Ríordáin (S&D) Subject:

Your Europe Advice is the only EU-funded service providing free, personalised legal advice to citizens, businesses and organisations across EU Member States. It handles more than 20 000 enquiries annually and provides essential support to SOLVIT centres and national advice organisations. It has come to my attention that the Commission’s Directorate-General for Internal Market, Industry, Entrepreneurship and SMEs intends to unilaterally discontinue this service without public consultation or any published impact assessment. 1.
Has the Commission conducted an impact assessment on the consequences of discontinuation for citizens, and if not, why?
What assessment has been made of the risks of directing citizens to AI tools for complex legal questions in the absence of this service?
Has consideration been given to the impact on SOLVIT and other directorates-general, and to transferring the service to another directorate-general rather than discontinuing it entirely?
